parameters.name: admin_state_up
parameters.description: Specifies the administrative state of the port. Choices: false true

parameters.name: allowed_address_pairs
parameters.description: Specifies a set of zero or more allowed address pairs.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The name of the Domain to scope to (Identity v3). Currently only domain names are supported, and not domain IDs.

parameters.name: extra_dhcp_opts
parameters.description: Specifies the extended option of DHCP.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of resource to be managed.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specifies the port name. The value can contain no more than 255 characters.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The name of the Tenant (Identity v2) or Project (Identity v3). Currently only project names are supported, and not project IDs.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region to which the project belongs.

parameters.name: security_groups
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the security group.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: subnet_id
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the subnet to which the port belongs.

parameters.name: timeouts
parameters.description: The timeouts for each operations. Default: {}

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user name to login with. Currently only user names are supported, and not user IDs.

examples:
# create a port
- name: Create vpc
  hwc_network_vpc:
    cidr: "192.168.100.0/24"
    name: "ansible_network_vpc_test"
  register: vpc
- name: Create subnet
  hwc_vpc_subnet:
    gateway_ip: "192.168.100.32"
    name: "ansible_network_subnet_test"
    dhcp_enable: true
    vpc_id: "{{ vpc.id }}"
    cidr: "192.168.100.0/26"
  register: subnet
- name: Create a port
  community.general.hwc_vpc_port:
    subnet_id: "{{ subnet.id }}"
    ip_address: "192.168.100.33"

return_values.name: admin_state_up
return_values.description: Specifies the administrative state of the port. Returned: success

return_values.name: allowed_address_pairs
return_values.description: Specifies a set of zero or more allowed address pairs. Returned: success

return_values.name: ip_address
return_values.description: Specifies the IP address. It cannot set it to 0.0.0.0. Configure an independent security group for the port if a large CIDR block (subnet mask less than 24) is configured for parameter allowed_address_pairs. Returned: success

return_values.name: mac_address
return_values.description: Specifies the MAC address. Returned: success

return_values.name: extra_dhcp_opts
return_values.description: Specifies the extended option of DHCP. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Specifies the option name. Returned: success

return_values.name: value
return_values.description: Specifies the option value. Returned: success

return_values.name: security_groups
return_values.description: Specifies the ID of the security group. Returned: success

return_values.name: subnet_id
return_values.description: Specifies the ID of the subnet to which the port belongs. Returned: success
